title: Motifs, tapestry, amigurumi na Tunisian: crochet na-ere

say: Motifs, tapestry, amigurumi na Tunisian: crochet na-ere.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul atọ nke Advanced Knitting na Crochet.
Crochet dị ngwa ma sie ike. Modul a na-ekpuchi ezinụlọ anọ na-ere nke ọma. Motifs ejikọtara na-eme blanketị na akpa. Tapestry crochet na-eme obere akpa.

panel.kicker: Ihe mere nke a ji dị mkpa
panel.heading: Ezinụlọ crochet anọ na-ere

Tapestry: akpa siri ike na obere akpa
Amigurumi: ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka juru
Tunisian: ịchafụ na akwa efere

say: Amigurumi na-eme ihe ụmụaka ji egwuri egwu juru, na crochet Tunisia na-eme ịchafụ na akwa efere nwere ọdịdị kpara akpa. Ntuziaka niile ebe a na-eji usoro US.

say: Nkà na-adịghị eme otu square. Ọ na-eme ka ọtụtụ square hà nhata. Na granny square kpochapụwo, okirikiri n nwere ugboro 4 n ụyọkọ. Ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ gị dị iche, square ahụ ga-agbagọ.
Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Bisi dị n'Akure na-eme otu square gburugburu 4, gbachie ya, ma ọ ruru 10 cm ma tụọ 9g.

panel.heading: Bisi na-eme atụmatụ akwa akwa nwa
items: Nnwale square: 10 cm gafee, 9 g
80 site na 100 cm: 8 x 10 = 80 square
Yarn: 80 x 9 g = 720 g
Tinye 15% maka njikọ na oke: 828 g
828/50 g bọọlụ = 16.6, yabụ zụta 17

say: Onye ahịa chọrọ ihe dịka 80 site na 100 cm. Nke ahụ bụ square 8 n'ofe na 10 ala: 80 square, na 720 g nke yarn.

panel.heading: Bisi na-eme atụmatụ akwa akwa nwa
items: Nnwale square: 10 cm gafee, 9 g
80 site na 100 cm: 8 x 10 = 80 square
Yarn: 80 x 9 g = 720 g
Tinye 15% maka njikọ na oke: 828 g
828/50 g bọọlụ = 16.6, yabụ zụta 17

say: Ọ na-agbakwụnye ihe dị ka pasent 15 maka ịbanye na oke, 828 g. Na bọọlụ 50 g bụ 16.6, yabụ ọ zụtara 17, niile sitere na otu akwa akwa. Ugbu a, ọ nwere ike ikwu ezigbo ọnụ ahịa yarn.

panel.rule: Tụọ ma tụọ otu square akpọchiri, wee mụbaa.

say: Ngwakọta stitch na-amị amị na-enye ọnụ ala ịchọ mma. Otu njikọ crochet siri ike, dị mma maka akpa ndị na-ebu ibu.

panel.heading: Họrọ njikọ maka ọrụ ahụ
items: Slip stitch: ihe eji achọ mma ewelitere elu
Otu crochet: siri ike, maka akpa
Ogbugbu: dị larịị, maka ihe ụmụaka
Jikọọ-dị ka ị na-aga: enweghị ọnụ mmiri dị iche

say: Ihe nkedo nke nwere agịga teepu dị larịị, dị mma maka uwe na ihe ụmụaka. Jikọọ-dị ka ị na-aga na-ejikọta square ọ bụla na agba ikpeazụ ya, nke na-azọpụta oge na akwa blanket.
Gbochie square ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ otu nha tupu ịbanye, wee buru ụzọ see okirikiri nhọrọ ukwuu.

say: Na crochet tapestry, ụcha ị na-adịghị eji na-adị n'akụkụ elu nke stitches, ị na-akpụkwa ya n'elu ya, ya mere a na-ezobe ya.

panel.heading: Gbanwee agba ma dabara na eserese ahụ
items: Buru agba B n'ime stitches
Setịpụ akaghị aka ikpeazụ: 2 na nko
Mechaa stitch ahụ na agba B
Zainab: isi okirikiri nke 60 stitches
60/12-stitch motif = 5 diamond

say: Ka ịgbanwee agba, na stitch ikpeazụ na agba A welitere akaghị aka, yabụ ị nwere loops 2 na nko. Mgbe ahụ jiri ụcha B were yarn kpuchie ya wee si na ha abụọ.

say: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Zainab dị na Kano nwere motif diamond 12 n'obosara. Ebe dị larịị ya na-agbakwụnye stitches 6 nke ọ bụla, ya mere, gburugburu 10 nwere 60. 60 nke kewara 12 bụ diamond 5. Ọ dabara, yabụ na ọ nweghị motif na-agbaji ebe agba na-amalite.

panel.rule: Ọgụgụ stitch nke okirikiri ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ nke obosara motif.

say: Amigurumi bụ obere ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka juru eju, na-arụ ọrụ na spirals otu crochet nwere akara na mmalite nke agba ọ bụla.
Malite na stitches 6 na mgbanaka anwansi, tinyekwa stitches 6 gburugburu: 12, 18, 24, 30.

panel.heading: Mpaghara-abawanye isii
items: 6 sc na mgbanaka anwansi
Tinye stitches 6 gburugburu ọ bụla: 12, 18, 24, 30
Na-arụ ọrụ dị larịị
Belata 6 kwa okirikiri, n'usoro enyo
Ngwa kwụsie ike, mechie 6 ikpeazụ

say: Na-arụ ọrụ dị larịị, wee belata 6 kwa okirikiri n'usoro enyo. Ngwa siri ike tupu agba nke ikpeazụ, ma mechie ya dị ka eriri eserese.
Tụgharịa na-abawanye na gburugburu ọ bụla, ma ọ bụ bọl ahụ na-atụgharị ka ọ bụrụ hexagon.

panel.rule: Tụgharịa na-abawanye, ma ọ bụ bọọlụ na-enweta akụkụ isii.

say: Nchekwa egwuregwu ụmụaka na-ebute ụzọ. Maka ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka na-erubeghị afọ 3, akwa akwa na anya na imi nwere yarn. Obere akụkụ ndị na-atọpụ bụ ihe egwu na-akpagbu.

panel.heading: Mee ka ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka ọ bụla nwee nchekwa

cards.d: Embroider anya na imi na yarn. Enweghị anya rọba, bọtịnụ ma ọ bụ bead nwere ike ịpụta.
Jiri nri ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka ọhụrụ dị ọcha. Na-adụ ụkwụ n'ahụ́ ọtụtụ ugboro.

cards.t: Were nwale ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka ọ bụla
cards.d: Dịrị akụkụ nke ọ bụla nke ọma tupu ị ere ma ọ bụ nye ya onyinye. Enweghị ogologo eriri ma ọ bụ loops.

say: Jiri ihe ọhụrụ eji egwuri egwu polyester dị ọcha, ọ bụghị ndochi ohiri isi ochie ma ọ bụ akwa akwa. Tụkwa aka na ntị n'ime ahụ ọtụtụ ugboro.

say: Nye ihe egwuri egwu ọ bụla n'akụkụ nke ọ bụla n'akụkụ ọ bụla tupu ị resị ya ma ọ bụ nye ya onyinye, ma zere eriri ogologo nwere ike kechie n'olu.

say: Crochet Tunisia na-eji nko ogologo ma na-edobe ọtụtụ loops na ya, dị ka agịga akwa. Na ngafe na-aga n'ihu ị na-ebuli loops. Na ngafe nloghachi, ị na-agbanyụ ha, abụọ n'otu oge. Ị naghị atụgharị ọrụ ahụ.

say: Tunisian akwa curls. Were nko buru ibu were luso ya ọgụ, yinye ntọala rụrụ arụ, oke, na mgbochi.

say: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Mercy na Benin City na-eme ịchafụ nke ahịrị 225. Ọ na-ewe ahịrị 10 na nkeji 25, yabụ nkeji 2.5 n'usoro. Site na oke na mgbochi, ịchafụ ọ bụla na-ewe ihe dịka awa 10.5. Ọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ site na ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ n'ezie, ọ bụghị ntule.

panel.rule: Oge ahịrị 10 wee mụbaa. Jiri ezigbo oge maka ọnụahịa.

say: Icheta. Tụọ ma tụọ otu square akpọchiri, wee mụbaa. Mee ka okirikiri ahụ gụọ ọtụtụ nke motif. Tinye stitches 6 nke ọ bụla na-abawanye gburugburu.
Njirimara ihe eji egwuri egwu maka ndị na-erubeghị 3 wee nwalee ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka ọ bụla. Na oge onwe gị, yabụ ọnụ ahịa gị na-eji ezigbo awa.

panel.heading: Cheta
items: Tua otu square, wee mụbaa
Tinye motif n'ime ọnụ ọgụgụ okirikiri
Tinye stitches 6 nke ọ bụla na-abawanye gburugburu
Njirimara embroider maka ndị na-erubeghị 3
Oge ahịrị 10 iji mara ezigbo awa gị

say: Ugbu a hazie otu motif oru ngo ma sonyere square abụọ. Malite obere akpa teepu site na eserese nke gị. Mee na dọpụta-nnwale a sphere. Ma mee swatch Tunisian nwere ndekọ oge.
Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
